properties.name: Former San Marcos Municipal Landfill
properties.method: Traced from Figure 5 of the Gary Job Corps Center Draft Environmental Assessment (U.S. Department of Labor, July 2022) and placed by fitting the figure's Tract IV and V outlines to appraisal district parcels (median difference about 14 feet). Approximate.

properties.label: West fuel dump
properties.quote: two fuel dumps, one at the east and one at the west ends of the airport ramp
properties.desc: West fuel dump. Soil sample #23 (4-6 ft) was proposed here.
properties.method: Location from the report's sketch map (labeled 'not to scale'), placed by matching its runways to a georeferenced aerial; approximate, within roughly 150 feet of the sketch.
